description:
Energy simulation for Energy Community v2 DEMO/TEST tenants (AB#4571 value
simulator, AB#4579 demo-community generator, AB#4703 presentable community
extension; used e.g. by the energydemo tenant, AB#4569). Ported / extended
from the voest-app energy simulator.

NOT for productive tenants — install only where synthetic metering data is
wanted. The blueprint is a separate, optional sibling of EnergyCommunity.Base
precisely so productive installs never carry it.

Installs two DataFlows / three pipelines:

create-demo-community (ec0000000000000000000b04, DataFlow …b05, AB#4579 + AB#4703)
  CREATES a fixed, PRESENTABLE, self-contained demo energy community so
  demo/test tenants need no hand-seeded data and no EDA:
  - 14 EnergyCommunity/Customer with obviously fictional Contact records
    (CustomerNumber auto-assigned via the Base-seeded AutoIncrement)
  - 14 Basic.Energy/OperatingFacility (the "EC Demo Community" shared
    facility owned by the community-operator customer + 13 member
    facilities; each facility is wired to exactly one customer via
    EnergyCommunity/AssociatedFacilities — inbound multiplicity One)
  - 14 EnergyCommunity/Consumer (…0801-0814) + 3 EnergyCommunity/Producer
    (…0901-0903) metering points (ParentChild to their facility, varied
    PartitionFactor 50-100)
  - 31 Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement anchors (consumers 2 OBIS codes,
    producers 1; well-known name <meteringPointRtId>_<obisCode>,
    ParentChild to the metering point)
  - 17 EnergyCommunity/ParticipationPeriod (one per metering point,
    2025-08-04 to a far-future end — Basic/TimeRange has no optional To)
  - 2 EnergyCommunity/EnergyPrice (consumption 0.18 / feed-in 0.10 EUR;
    the type has only Price + Currency, roles encoded in well-known names)
  Idempotent — every entity is upserted via GetOrCreateRtEntitiesByType@1
  keyed on a stable natural key (facility Name, metering-point
  MeteringPointNumber, customer/anchor/period/price RtWellKnownName), so
  re-running never duplicates. The Producer subtype is
  EnergyCommunity/Producer (exact type the value simulator classifies as
  PV), NOT Basic.Energy/Producer.

energy-simulator / energy-simulator-range (…b02 / …b03, AB#4571)
  Generate deterministic synthetic 15-minute metering values for the
  Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement ANCHOR entities that already exist in the
  tenant (they do not create any entities): PV curve for anchors whose
  parent metering point is an EnergyCommunity/Producer (default 50 kWp
  peak), BDEW H0 load profile for all others (default 500 kWh/day), one
  datapoint per 15-minute slot, written into the Base 2.x raw archive
  energy-measurements (ec0000000000000000000a01).
  - energy-simulator (…b02): fixed backfill window (startDate 2025-01-01,
    numDays 365 — edit the pipeline definition to reshape the dataset)
  - energy-simulator-range (…b03): on-demand variant; startDate + numDays
    come from the ExecutePipelineCommand input
    (e.g. an input file: { "startDate": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z", "numDays": 3 }, passed via ExecutePipeline -f)

Self-contained flow for a fresh demo/test tenant:
  ExecutePipeline create-demo-community  (creates master data + anchors)
  ExecutePipeline energy-simulator-range (fills the raw archive)
  ./backfill-rollups.ps1                 (populates the rollup ladder)

DISABLED BY DEFAULT: all three pipelines are seeded with System/Enabled =
false and are triggered exclusively via FromExecutePipelineCommand@1
(nothing time- or event-triggered), so a fresh install can never create or
write data on its own. To run: enable the pipeline, DeployDataFlow /
DeployPipeline (Mesh Adapter 670…002 must be online), ExecutePipeline, then
re-apply the blueprint (InstallBlueprint -f) to restore the disabled seed
state. See src/blueprints/README.md ("Simulation") for the full runbook.

Prerequisites:
- EnergyCommunity.Base 2.x installed and the energy-measurements archives
  activated (install-tenant.ps1 ActivateArchive phase)
- For the value simulators only: EnergyMeasurement anchor entities exist
  (well-known name <meteringPointRtId>_<obisCode>, System/ParentChild to
  the metering point) — created by create-demo-community, by EDA ingest
  (EnergyCommunity.EdaIntegration), or seeded as test master data
